items.text: Develop and maintain scalable and secure backend systems for web applications.
Design and implement RESTful APIs and ensure efficient data flow between frontend and backend.
Optimize backend performance, scalability, and service reliability.
Work with authentication and authorization mechanisms to enhance security.
Implement database management, indexing, and caching to improve efficiency.
Utilize background jobs and messaging queues for handling asynchronous tasks.
Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot backend services using logging and error tracking tools.
Collaborate with frontend engineers, DevOps, and product managers to ensure smooth system operation.
Stay updated with backend development trends and security best practices.

description.text:
1. Develop and maintain scalable and secure backend systems for web applications.
(開發與維護可擴展且安全的後端系統，支援網頁應用程式)
2. Design and implement RESTful APIs and ensure efficient data flow between frontend and backend.
(設計與開發 RESTful API，確保前後端之間的高效數據傳輸)
3. Optimize backend performance, scalability, and service reliability.
(優化後端效能、可擴展性與服務可靠性)
4. Work with authentication and authorization mechanisms to enhance security.
(實作身份驗證與授權機制，提高系統安全性)
5. Implement database management, indexing, and caching to improve efficiency.
(管理數據庫，進行索引與快取優化，以提升效能)
6. Utilize background jobs and messaging queues for handling asynchronous tasks.
(使用背景作業與消息佇列來處理非同步任務)
7. Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot backend services using logging and error tracking tools.
(部署、監控與除錯後端服務，使用日誌與錯誤追蹤工具)
8. Collaborate with frontend engineers, DevOps, and product managers to ensure smooth system operation.
(與前端工程師、DevOps 及產品經理合作，確保系統運行順暢)
9. Stay updated with backend development trends and security best practices.
(關注最新的後端開發趨勢與安全性最佳實踐)
